products.title: The Salt Orchard — Hardback Fiction
products.description: A debut novel following three generations of a coastal farming family. 384 pages, hardback with a sewn binding.

products.title: Notes from the Estuary — Nature Writing
products.description: A year of field notes from a tidal estuary, illustrated with the author's own pen drawings. 248 pages, hardback.

products.title: The Cartographers' War — History
products.description: A narrative history of eighteenth-century surveying disputes and the borders they left behind. 512 pages, paperback.

products.title: Collected Poems of the Northern School
products.description: An anthology gathering forty poets across five decades, with a critical introduction. 640 pages, hardback.

products.title: The Long Kitchen — Cookery
products.description: A cookbook of slow, one-pot cooking arranged by season. 272 pages, hardback, photographed throughout.

products.title: Foxglove Staff Picks Bundle
products.description: Three titles chosen by our booksellers, wrapped in paper with a handwritten note explaining each choice.

products.title: Linen Bookmark, Set of Three
products.description: Three woven linen bookmarks with hand-finished ends, in oatmeal, moss and indigo.

products.title: Foxglove Canvas Book Bag
products.description: A 12oz cotton canvas tote with a reinforced base and a printed shop mark. Holds a heavy hardback without sagging.

pages.about: Foxglove Books is an independent bookshop that has been trading for eleven years. Our booksellers read what they recommend, and every staff pick on the site carries a note from whoever chose it. We host readings on the last Thursday of the month.
pages.refund_policy: Books may be returned within 30 days of delivery in resaleable condition for a full refund. Damaged or misprinted copies are replaced at our cost with no return required. Signed and special editions are non-returnable unless faulty.
pages.shipping_policy: Orders dispatched within 1 business day. Standard delivery $3.95, free over $35, arriving in 2-4 business days. Books are sent in rigid board wraps rather than padded envelopes.
